name: Sticky Sections Dim
description: Full-screen cards stack as you scroll. Each card dims, shifts up and lets its image rotate away while the next card slides over it. Includes a hero intro, a numbered counter and a closing statement.
contents: Hero header with title and description
Sticky full-screen cards, each with image, title, text and counter
Optional full-screen loader until images load
behavior: Cards stick to the top and are dimmed by brightness and contrast filters as the next card covers them
Card image moves up and rotates, with a contrast fade-in as it enters
Last card stays undimmed when keepLastSection is true
Optional Lenis smooth scrolling, skipped when reduced motion is preferred

props.name: heroDescription
props.default: As data conglomerates reveled in the opulence of cognitive wealth, a silent underclass manifested, condemned to the digital periphery.

props.name: outro
props.default: Lost in perpetual dependency, inhabitants of the Synthetic Era found solace in cryptic simulations, where pain ebbed and cognitive loads momentarily lightened.

editableByProps: Hero text, closing text, all card images, titles, texts and card colors
Page background, text and loader colors, card radius, image size
Dim strength, shift, image rotation, easing, scroll length and sticky offset
Smooth scroll settings and the loader toggle

needsCodeEdit.change: Change dimming of the stacked cards
needsCodeEdit.where: filter tween in the first gsap timeline inside gsap.context

fixed: Takes over page scrolling with Lenis when smoothScroll is on, so it should be the only smooth scroll on the page
Hero header has an 80vh minimum height and the outro has 50vh top and 30vh bottom padding
Each card fills the viewport height
Loader overlay covers the whole screen until images load
